name: Heal Back Stronger (General)
body:
Your body is resilient and springs back from even the most punishing wounds. After magical healing, your restored body seems even more impressive.

Prerequisite(s): Toughness, Con 13

Benefit(s): If at full hit points, any excess magical healing is retained at temporary hit points. These temporary hit points remain for one minute.

Normal: Excess healing is simply wasted, and cannot raise you above your full normal hit point total.
